messages:
Maya Chen: NovaWare wants a VPC/on-prem POC starting next Tue. They asked to waive the one-time platform fee for the eval and upgrade to Gold support. Can Deal Desk approve a fee waiver + intro discount? @Jordi what ops/SE lift?

Jordi Alvarez: We can do Gold but need 12-16h SE (env prep, SSO, KMS review) and dedicated nodes reserved for the POC to meet latency SLOs. Ops needs 48-72h lead time. I will add reservation steps to the SOW.

Priya Singh: Numbers: platform fee = $50k; annual license = $120k. 25% off year1 = $30k. Waive fee + discount is ~80k impact. Recommend tighter terms.

Priya Singh: Counter: waive fee for POC only if customer signs a 12-month paid license >= $140k within 75 days of POC end and cap discount at 15% OR allow 20% discount if commit >=$140k within 60 days. This lowers our exposure.

Maya Chen: Customer needs low upfront cost. I'll present both options. Procurement likely ~60 days.

Owen Patel: Legal ok with a conversion/recoup clause. Suggested clause: "If Customer executes a 12-month paid license >= $140,000 within 75 days of POC completion, Redwood will credit the waived one-time platform fee to Customer's first invoice. Otherwise the waived fee will be treated as consideration for evaluation services." Also add KMS/data residency acceptance language.

Jordi Alvarez: SOW items: 16h SE, dedicated capacity reservation, ops lead/contact, KMS checklist. Ops: reserve nodes at least 48h prior.

Maya Chen: Which option should go in the Deal Desk request?

Priya Singh: Submit request for: waive platform fee for POC, 20% year1 discount conditional on >=$140k commit within 75 days, SE hours and dedicated nodes in SOW. Finance prefers 75 days.

deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk Request DD-2026-333 submitted by @Maya Chen - waive platform fee for POC, 20% first-year discount, credit-on-commit >= $140k within 75 days clause, SE hours + dedicated nodes in SOW. Action: APPROVE / DENY / COUNTER.

Owen Patel: Approve clause wording.

Priya Singh: Finance approve pending SOW shows ops cost center and invoice schedule.

deal-desk-bot: DD-2026-333 status: APPROVED (Priya Singh, Owen Patel). Terms recorded.

Maya Chen: I'll update SOW and post link here for countersign with NovaWare. Thanks team :tada:
